questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: This room is three times (   ) that one.
questions.explanation: 倍数 + as 〜 as で「…の～倍」。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: The (   ) you read, the more you learn.
questions.explanation: the + 比較級 〜, the + 比較級 … で「〜すればするほど…」。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: He is taller than (   ) other boy in his class.
questions.explanation: 比較級 + than any other + 単数名詞 は最上級と同じ意味。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: She is (   ) the smartest student in the school.
questions.explanation: 最上級を強めるのは by far / much。
